title: Hand Window
description: Uses both hands' thumb and index fingertips to open an audio-reactive coloured-glass window in Source A, revealing Source B below.

parameters.label: Reveal
parameters.description: Amount of Source B shown inside the fingertip window.

parameters.label: Window Size
parameters.description: Scales the four-point window around its centre.

parameters.label: Window Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the glass over Source B inside the window.

parameters.label: Colour Mix
parameters.description: Strength of the coloured-glass mix while preserving Source B detail.

parameters.label: Glass Effect
parameters.description: Adds progressively richer refraction, colour dispersion and frosted-glass sampling.

parameters.label: Softness
parameters.description: Softness of the transition between Source A and Source B.

parameters.label: Invert Colour
parameters.description: Inverts Source B colours inside the active window.

parameters.label: Invert Window
parameters.description: Shows Source B outside the four-point window instead.

parameters.label: Show Skeleton
parameters.description: Shows the detected hand bones and landmarks for setup and debugging.
